notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and a read of what the case's probes name.

cases.note: a merge that changes the values, takes a2 away and adds a3 and d: the kept pieces' shapes tween (update timing, no row), a new piece grows r from r0 (enter timing, its row), a2 goes at once; a kept label moves from its old x / y / rotation, a new one fades in
the sunburst's own update timing (500 ms, cubicInOut): a merge that only changes values; the labels turned radially
a second merge 200 ms into the first: every kept piece tweens on from where it is

a merge that only changes values (the same names: the hierarchical diff pairs every node): every kept group and rect tweens from its old place and shape (animationDurationUpdate 1000, linear, no delay)

a merge that takes b2 away and adds a3 under a and d at the top: the new elements come out of their parent's old corner and fade in, b2's shrink to b's centre and fade; the default timing (900 ms, quinticInOut)
a merge that renames a1 and moves c into b: the diff is by name within each parent, so the renamed one is new and the old one deleted, c leaves the top and comes in under b

a graph on a view: a merge writes zoom 2 and a centre -- the main group tweens to the new view transform (update timing, no row), the compensation scale is set at once, the nodes stay at their place in the group
a tree: a merge writes zoom 1.5 -- the view group tweens (update timing, no row); every node keeps its place in the group
a geo component: a merge writes zoom 2 and a centre -- MapDraw's transform group tweens to the new roam transform (the geo's model: the global update timing, 300 ms cubicInOut)
a map series drawing its own map: a merge writes zoom 1.5 and a centre -- its MapDraw's transform group tweens on the series' model (its own update timing: 800 ms linear)

a force layout without layoutAnimation: the legend switches category B off and on again -- each layout starts from preservedPoints by node id (a node switched off keeps its last place there), not from the option's x / y
a force layout without layoutAnimation: a merge renames d to f and adds g -- the kept nodes start from their preserved points, the new ones (no preserved point) from the random box

a step line whose step changes from start to end: LineView's init branch -- a new polyline, the clip grows from nothing again (enter timing, 1000 ms linear), every symbol pops in again on its delay and its label fades
a plain line that becomes a step line (step 'middle') with a value changed: the same init branch, nothing tweens from the old points
a step line merged with the same step and a new value: the update branch (the stepped points tween), for contrast

orthogonal LR, curve edges: a merge takes a2 (and its child a21) away and adds b3 under b -- the rows shift, the diff pairs the nodes by name; a2 goes to a's OLD place + 1 and a21 to a2's old place + 1 (the old tree's parent chain, the old data's layout), their edges to the same; b3 grows out of b's old place

orient TB, polyline edges: a merge takes a away (and a1, a2, a21 with it) and gives c two children -- the removed subtree shrinks into its OLD parents' old places; a's TreePath goes to the root's old place, a2's (an only child under it) to a's; c's children and its new TreePath come out of c's place

guards.name: sb-merge: a kept piece tweens its shape
sb-merge: a new piece grows from r0
sb-merge: a new label fades in
map-roam: the series transform group tweens
force-legend: the kept nodes do not restart from the option
tree-data: a2 goes to a's old place + 1
